climatology.coherence: train rates are nested (label nesting), hence coherent; verified anyway
climatology.rule: per-fold TRAIN-state empirical rate per threshold; constant over validation states

grid.grid_zero: pit-lane starters (0) score 1.0 on all thresholds: deterministic, causal, documented overconfidence

l2_logistic_control.C_rationale: frozen V3.1B/V3.3 lineage value (FROZEN_LOGR_C); fixed before fitting; no tuning
l2_logistic_control.scope: four independent binary models, one per threshold; control, not search

position_persistence.null_position_fallback: per-fold train climatology rate for that threshold (261 null states corpus-wide; causal: train stats only)
position_persistence.rule: p_topK = 1.0 if current position <= K else 0.0

bootstrap.role: validation infrastructure, not a C significance gate

d_candidate_boundary: Narrow: a small number of reasonable independent binary probabilistic families reusing this harness. Ordinal/ranking/survival/exact-position-multiclass stay closed per A unless a later contract amends with justification. No D models selected by performance in C.

d_interface.fit: fit(train_X: 110-col frame, train_targets: 4 binary cols) -> fitted bundle
d_interface.predict: predict_proba(validation_X) -> 4 RAW probabilities in frozen threshold order [top1, top3, top5, top10]
d_interface.redefinition: FORBIDDEN (D must not redefine the harness)

firewall_2025.mechanism: seasons 2018-2024 filter + 2025 tripwire + ProtectedHoldoutError + artifact scan + tests

immutability: frozen before first learned fit; any change requires a new contract version

preprocessing.fit_on: outer TRAIN only; applied unchanged to validation
preprocessing.module: frozen Model Lab PRE.fit_preprocessor (harness fit_family path)

primary_metric.definition: per threshold: race-macro binary log loss (eps 1e-15) over sidecar states; primary = unweighted mean of the 4 values
primary_metric.evaluation_states: all sidecar states (each a causal T-snapshot); race-macro gives equal race weight (no cross-driver synchronization needed for per-driver marginals)
primary_metric.name: mean_race_macro_log_loss_over_4_thresholds
